original_content_full: The paper "Tooling for Time- and Space-efficient git Repository Mining" by Fabian Heseding, Willy Scheibel, and Jürgen Döllner was accepted for publication and presentation at the 2022 Mining Software Repositories Conference. The conference will take place both as virtual and in-person event between May 18-24, 2022.
